commands.name: cmd-run-job
commands.title: run ‹job›
commands.subtitle: clfly
commands.description: Run a job on a surface, one unit (chapter, film, file) at a time;

commands.name: cmd-run-job--align-hp4-full-cast
commands.title: run align-hp4-full-cast
commands.subtitle: clfly
commands.description: Forced-align Goblet of Fire (Audible UK full cast) one chapter per unit. Audio comes from the bucket into audiobooks/4/full-cast before the units run (files already here are kept), or put it there with align job run <audio-job> --fetch-only.

commands.name: cmd-run-job--align-hp5-full-cast-vote-recombine
commands.title: run align-hp5-full-cast-vote-recombine
commands.subtitle: clfly
commands.description: Recombine HP5 Full Cast from the finished vote passes in data/align/b5.json.vote/ (no aligner pass runs when all 38 chapters are in each pass file), so a vote fix (PR align-vote-order: rigid's end with rigid's start, enforce_order) reaches data/align/b5.json without a GPU re-run. Runs align qa (no --skip-qa).

commands.name: cmd-run-job--align-hp5-full-cast-vote
commands.title: run align-hp5-full-cast-vote
commands.subtitle: clfly
commands.description: Re-align Order of the Phoenix (Audible UK full cast) with align align --vote, one chapter per unit: rigid, sparse-join and whisper-anchored passes under data/align/b5.json.vote/, then whisper-onset with rigid's start where sparse-close-gaps backs it. Needs the word transcripts from whisper-words-hp5-full-cast. Each unit merges its chapter into data/align/b5.json.

commands.name: cmd-run-job--bench-align-shadow
commands.title: run bench-align-shadow
commands.subtitle: clfly
commands.description: align --vote throughput on the Shadow: HP5 full-cast chapter 32 (2,248 s) per unit, each into its own scratch out (.scratch/bench/align/<unit>/b5.json, never data/align), varying --threads; phase timings per vote pass land in the ledger. A unit's out dir must be deleted before rerunning it, since vote passes resume. `bench-align-shadow` units named beside-* are concurrency trials: start them together with the matching bench-whisper-shadow unit.

commands.name: cmd-run-job--bench-whisper-shadow
commands.title: run bench-whisper-shadow
commands.subtitle: clfly
commands.description: Whisper throughput sweep on the Shadow: one HP5 full-cast chapter (ch 32, 2,248 s) transcribed with large-v3 --words per unit, varying --batch-size and --compute-type, each into its own scratch dir with --force. Compare with `run units bench-whisper-shadow --on shadow` (x real time, SM, power, VRAM). Run with nothing else on the GPU unless the unit is a concurrency trial.

commands.name: cmd-run-job--separate-batch
commands.title: run separate-batch
commands.subtitle: clfly
commands.description: Stem separation in the borkxs/mashups repo: one song per unit, names from in/separate.txt (one per line, matching in/<name>.mp3|wav|flac|m4a). scripts/separate.py skips a name whose stems exist, so a lost ledger costs nothing. bsroformer (best vocal, ~1 min on the Shadow GPU, ~25 min on the Mac CPU) by default; htdemucs on the laptop. Stems are 40 MB wavs, so they are bucket artifacts; the audio comes down as a job input.

commands.name: cmd-run-job--shots-batch
commands.title: run shots-batch
commands.subtitle: clfly
commands.description: One film per unit: TransNetV2 shot detection streamed from its CDN link, then build.mjs (clips, posters, thumbs). Units come from apps/shots/films.local.json (git-ignored: the links are personal and expire), e.g. [{"id": "prestige", "url": "https://...", "title": "The Prestige (2006)"}]. shots.json goes to git; media goes to the bucket.

commands.name: cmd-run-job--transcribe-batch
commands.title: run transcribe-batch
commands.subtitle: clfly
commands.description: faster-whisper transcription, one audio file per unit, from the paths in data/transcripts/inputs.txt (one per line, absolute or relative to the repo). Writes data/transcripts/batch/<stem>.json, .txt and .srt. transcribe skips files it already finished, so a lost ledger costs nothing.

commands.name: cmd-run-job--whisper-words-hp5-full-cast
commands.title: run whisper-words-hp5-full-cast
commands.subtitle: clfly
commands.description: Word-level Whisper transcripts (faster-whisper large-v3, --words) of every Order of the Phoenix full-cast chapter, into the align eval transcript dir; files already transcribed there (ch 1, ch 31 from the eval) are skipped. Needed by align-hp5-full-cast-vote.
